schema.description: The identification of a particular Parameter Type for a particular Facility or Process.
schema.title: Emission Activity Parameter

emission_activity_parameter_id.description: The Primary Key of the Emission Activity Parameter.

parent_emission_activity_parameter_id.description: Foreign Key of the Parent Emission Activity Parameter. This may be used to reference an Emission Activity Parameter converter from one Unit Of Measure to another.

physical_quantity_type_id.description: Optional part of a composite Foreign Key of the parent Unit Of Measure. Identifies the Physical Quantity Type of the activity parameter; e.g., density (mass per volume) or equivalent Global Warming Potential (GWP) of a gas (mass per mass).

emission_activity_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Emission Activity to which this Emission Activity Parameter is assigned.

unit_of_measure_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Unit Of Measure assigned to the Emission Activity Parameter.

name.description: The name assigned to the Emission Activity Parameter.

facility_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Facility to which this Emission Activity Parameter is directly linked (if available).

emission_parameter_type_id.description: DEPRECATED, to be replaced by Physical Quantity Type Id identified by the parent Unit Of Measure Id. Assigns a a reference type to the parameter.

equipment_id.description: The Foreign Key of the Equipment to which this Emission Activity Parameter is directly linked (if available).

id.description: Unique identifier of an OSDU record.

version.description: Version number of this OSDU record.
